svg.title: Historian compression – swinging door and exception deadband
svg.text: 06 – Historian compression on a spindle warm-up curve (61 raw samples, every 10 s)
Top: swinging door, compression deviation E = 0.5 °C → 7 points stored. Bottom: exception deadband 0.5 °C (step hold) → 35 points stored.
Swinging door (SDT), E = 0.5 °C: stored at t = 0, 80, 170, 240, 350, 530, 600 s · compression 61/7 = 8.7 : 1
Each door can only close (turn inwards); the stored straight line passes all skipped points at about ±E.
Exception deadband 0.5 °C (store if |new − last stored| > 0.5): 35 points · 61/35 = 1.7 : 1 · error ≤ 0.5 °C (hold)
Legend: ○ raw sample (every 10 s) ■ stored point red line = what the historian reconstructs (SDT: straight lines; exception: hold last value).
Measured max. error: SDT 0.70 °C (typical ≤ E, worst case about 2 × E); exception 0.50 °C (≤ deadband). Curve: T = 30 + 40·(1 − e^(−t/200 s)) + noise.
